description: Moving a card balance to a 0% balance transfer offer: the fee, the monthly payment that clears it before the 0% ends, what's left when it ends at a given payment and what that then costs, and the saving against staying on the card it's on now. Use for 'is a 0% balance transfer worth it on £4,000', 'how much a month to clear it in 24 months'.

balance.description: The balance to move, in pounds.

currentAprPct.description: The rate on the card the balance is on now, e.g. 24.9.

feePct.description: The transfer fee as a % of the balance, e.g. 3. Added to the balance.

monthlyPayment.description: What would be paid each month, the same on either card, in pounds.

rateAfterPct.description: The new card's rate once the 0% ends. Defaults to currentAprPct.

zeroMonths.description: How long the 0% lasts, in whole months, 1 to 60.

name: calculate_balance_transfer
title: 0% Balance Transfer Planner
